title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claim-History Factor on Re-Settlement After Recovery
content:
When a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim is re-settled after stolen property is recovered, the re-settlement deductible is multiplied by the re-settlement's claim-history factor, which counts the **other** paid claims on the plan — paid claims besides the claim being re-settled — with a loss date in the 36 whole months before the handling date.

| Other paid claims on the plan with a loss date in the 36 whole months before the handling date | Claim-history factor |
| --- | --- |
| three or more | 1.75 |
| exactly two | 1.5 |
| exactly one | 1.25 |
| none | 1 |

**Notes.** The claim being re-settled is not one of the other paid claims. A paid claim is a claim of this plan whose handling status is paid.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** The plan has three paid claims with loss dates in the 36-month window, one of them the claim being re-settled: two other paid claims, so the re-settlement deductible is multiplied by 1.5.
